sourceFile: 54.2. BRS-161014  Report checking NTI of test Frame improvement type C date 28.10.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable Normal vs Test evidence but the changed-factor and measurement grouping are not reliable enough for final use.
issues: Changed factor uses filename and leaves baseline/test conditions unspecified.
SPL/THD/IMP outcomes are grouped as generic detected tables, not NTI metrics.
FO subresults are misparsed as row-index sequences instead of FO values.
ST/MASK/reference columns are mixed with Normal/Test conditions without role separation.
Evidence is mostly header or partial rows and omits likely summary context.
correctionPlan: Set primary comparison to NORMAL baseline vs TEST frame improvement type C, with ST/MASK as reference or subgroup context.
Create separate outcomes for SPL, THD, IMP, and FO under the same validation report context.
Recompute FO statistics from the numeric FO values for TEST and NORMAL samples.
Use actual data and summary rows from each sheet, not only headers, for citations.
Preserve sample IDs and any ST/reference columns distinctly from the main comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are insufficient for final evidence because grouping and parsed values are unreliable.
